t: The Nebo Blueline Rechargeable LED Head Torch delivers powerful, hands-free lighting for trade and site work. Producing up to 1000lm with a 219m beam, it features various light modes including 'Strobe' for safety and signalling. The Flex-Power system allows use with rechargeable or alkaline batteries for added convenience. Built with a magnetic base, adjustable nylon headband, and IPX4 water resistance, to provide durability and comfort for indoor or outdoor use in demanding conditions. Run time varies depending on selected light mode: High (1000lm for 2 hours), Medium (500lm for 4 hours), and Low (100lm for 16 hours).
